title: CNMD - RoadTransportNode schema
description: A node in a road transport network, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be RoadTransportNode.

accidents.description: Property. Number of accidents recorded at the node during a specific observation period. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

capacityVehiclesPerHour.description: Property. Vehicle capacity per hour. Units:'C62'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

connects.description: Relationship. Road segments that meet at this node.

dailyTrafficVolume.description: Property. Daily traffic volume, normally expressed in vehicles per day. Units:'C62'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

formType.description: Property. Physical form of the road node.

infrastructureElements.description: Property. Infrastructure elements at the node, such as traffic lights and pedestrian crossings.

lastMaintenance.description: Property. Date and time of the last maintenance operation. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

nextMaintenance.description: Property. Date and time scheduled for the next maintenance operation. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

peakHourCongestion.description: Property. Congestion level during peak hour.

pedestrianFacilities.description: Property. Pedestrian facilities, including crossings and accessibility features. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

signalTiming.description: Property. Traffic-light timing information, including cycle time, phases and adaptive control. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

trafficLightControlled.description: Property. Whether the node is controlled by traffic lights. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

trafficManagement.description: Property. Traffic-management systems, including camera monitoring and adaptive control. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.
